fields.value: Recycling reversed: Studies in the History of Polyphony in the northern Low Countries

value: Late medieval court culture in the northern Low Countries: Visualizing, interpreting, and contextualizing music fragments

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset stems from the NWO project “Late medieval court culture in the northern Low Countries: Visualizing, interpreting, and contextualizing music fragments” which run from September 2013 to May 2018 at Utrecht University. Its deliverable is Eliane Fankhauser’s PhD dissertation titled “Recycling reversed: Studies in the History of Polyphony in the northern Low Countries.” The research project addressed fragments of polyphonic music kept in The Netherlands from around 1400 with a special consideration of a collection of fragments housed at Utrecht University (RISM sigla NL-Uu Hs. 6 E 37 (Cat. 1846), referred to as Uu 37 in the dissertation). In contextualizing the fragments, archival research on the cultural milieu in Utrecht around 1400 was carried out.

value:
Utrecht fragments NL-Uu Hs. 6 E 37 (Cat. 1846), short siglum Uu 37

Leiden fragments NL-Lu B.P.L. 2720, NL-Lu L.T.K 342A, NL-Lu B.P.L. 2515 (1)

Amsterdam fragments NL-Au 64

dansRelationText.value: the Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music, NL-Uu Hs. 6 E 37 (Cat. 1846)
the Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music, NL-B.P.L. 2720
the Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music, NL-L.T.K. 342A
the Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music, NL-B.P.L. 2515 (1)
the Digital Image Archive of Medieval Music, NL-Au Ms. ES 64
Fankhauser, E. A. (2018). Recycling Reversed: Studies in the History of Polyphony in the Northern Low Countries Around 1400 (Doctoral dissertation, Utrecht University).
A relation to the dissertation to which this dataset belongs can only be made after the defense (18 May 2018)
